Questioner Jasin is charged with interrogating prisoners in Moonrise Towers Prison with  Sumera during Act Two.
“
Plant one foot in front of the other. Head forward, back straight. Make them fear you.
„
— Jasin

Involvement

Act Two

Torturing Minthara

Main article: Decide Minthara's Fate

If  Minthara is present in the prison, Jasin can be found alongside her sister, Questioner  Sumera, working to break Minthara's mind.

Without Minthara

If Minthara did not survive Act One, Jasin is still found in the prison. She wonders aloud to Sumera when they will get new "playthings."

Defending Moonrise Towers

If the  Nightsong is freed and the Harpers launch the assault on Moonrise Towers, Jasin is killed and her body can be found amongst the dead bodies on the entrance bridge.

Idle banter

If Minthara is present, Sumera and Jasin question Minthara:

  • Questioner Jasin
    Do you yet recall your name, prisoner?
  • Nightwarden Minthara
    Minthara Baenre.
  • Questioner Sumera
    We will take it from you soon.
  • Nightwarden Minthara
    Queen of Spiders, I beseech of you the strength to destroy my foes.
  • Questioner Sumera
    Lolth cannot hear you. She has forsaken you.
  • Questioner Jasin
    There are no gods left to you, Minthara. You are alone.
  • Questioner Sumera
    You are despised, Minthara.
  • Questioner Jasin
    A blemish in the Absolute's design.
  • Questioner Sumera
    We will cleanse you.
  • Questioner Jasin
    How can you hope to resist the voice of a god?
  • Nightwarden Minthara
    It is no god.
  • Questioner Sumera
    Blasphemer!
